items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: But I made a few arrangements for Art Kassel and his orchestra and he paid me for them.

ctx.x: And you don't make any money either. (LAUGHTER).

Scores. Well I wasn't making any money. But I made a few arrangements for Art Kassel and his orchestra and he paid me for them. But see it was too confining and both he and I decided we'd rather be players than composers or arrangers. But, so I did get a fairly good education.
Well tell me something now. That's a fascinating thing that you've just said. But you worked with Benny Goodman and everybody knows he's certainly very, very famous.
